claim: The CLI makes no network requests and writes only to local files.
sandbox: fresh temporary directory; bundled CLI demo

claim: A TOML manifest lists the collection items before capture.
Preview reads nothing and runs no commands.
Supported version commands run only after approval.
Common secrets are redacted before copied logs reach the review folder.
Configuration items record a SHA-256 fingerprint instead of file contents.
Only supported collection types and project-relative paths are accepted.
Inspection reports each review file, size, and SHA-256 fingerprint.
Export works only after inspection and blocks changed review files.
The packet ZIP contains the inspected report and redacted evidence, not executables.
Demo uses sample data and separate browser storage.
The documentation and demo work offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh browser context, offline after service-worker activation

claim: The source install command is free and builds the documented binary.
CLI commands have help, JSON output where documented, CI-safe approval, and documented exit codes.
npm run build creates dist/diagnostic-packet and dist/site/.
The documentation site has no analytics, cookies, accounts, or third-party scripts.
Clearing site data removes the documentation cache.
The demo stages work with arrow keys, Home, and End.
Demo, legal pages, and a designed not-found page have distinct titles and routes.
